name: San Germán (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and purple charged at the centre with the city arms: the green for episcopal dignity and the arms of Diego Colón, the white for the purity of the founding families and the purple for the arms of Juan Ponce de León.
history: San Germán is a historic town and municipality in southwestern Puerto Rico, the island's second oldest settlement. According to Flags of the World the order of the bands was confirmed by Mayor Isidro Negrón Irizarry as green, white and purple from the top.

features.role: arms of the city with a mural crown
